$comment: Preview-only concept artwork. Kept out of public/images/ on purpose so it can never be mistaken for, or bundled with, the real photo library.
status: AI-GENERATED CONCEPT VISUALS — NOT ACTUAL PHOTOGRAPHS OF MINI ALLEY PALLY
subject: Mini Alley Pally — a small stationary shed/kiosk-style refreshment point inside the Pickleball Central premises, Parvathapur
createdBy: Mixed. The two SVGs: Claude (Claude Code), hand-authored vector, 2026-10-19. mini-kiosk-golden-hour.png: supplied by PG on 2026-10-21, generated by an image model outside this repository. Claude did not produce it and cannot verify how it was prompted.
method: Hand-authored SVG for the two vector assets; a raster image-generation model for mini-kiosk-golden-hour.png. The SVGs carry the words CONCEPT ILLUSTRATION inside the artwork; the PNG does not, so every page that uses it must label it on screen.
permittedUse: Local design-preview routes under /design-preview-v2 (all three colour versions)
Local design-preview routes under /design-preview-v4, always with a visible 'illustration, not a photograph' label
prohibitedUse: Google Business Profile or any other listing
Any context that presents them as documentary images of the premises
Mixing into public/images/ or any real-photograph library
accuracyNotes: Scale is drawn deliberately modest: one serving hatch, one counter, two small tables. It must not suggest a building, a kitchen or a full cafe.
The menu board is drawn blank and marked MENU TBC because no Mini menu has been verified.
No opening hours, prices, dish names or offers appear in the artwork.
The pickleball court, net and player figures are generic and abstract; they are not a depiction of Pickleball Central's actual courts, branding or layout.
Nail Studio by Sahithi is not depicted.

mini-kiosk-golden-hour.png is an IMAGINED scene, not a record of the premises. It is markedly more built-out and more lush than the real kiosk, which is a small stationary shed with a few chairs and tables nearby.

That image contains invented signage and wording — a chalkboard reading 'Good Coffee Brighter Games' and a branded 'PICKLEBALL CENTRAL' banner. Neither is approved brand copy and neither has been verified; the slogan must not be reused as Alley Pally messaging, and the banner is not Pickleball Central's actual branding.

It also depicts specific goods (pastries under glass, espresso equipment, a printed menu board) and a member of staff. None of that is confirmed for Mini, whose menu and facilities remain unverified. It must never be used to imply an offering.

assets.shows: The kiosk at the edge of a pickleball court, with its awning, sign, serving hatch and two outdoor tables.
assets.usedAt: /design-preview-v2/{warm-clay|garden-shade|slow-morning}/mini — hero; and the Mini location card on every homepage

assets.shows: Closer view of the serving counter, the little equipment there is, a blank board, and one table with two chairs.
A compact wooden café kiosk at golden hour, wrapped in greenery, with small outdoor tables and chairs, and a pickleball court behind it.
assets.provenance: Supplied by PG, 2026-10-21. AI-generated. Not a photograph of Mini Alley Pally.
assets.usedAt: /design-preview-v4/mini — atmospheric supporting image, labelled on screen

thirdAssetSkipped: A wider contextual view (Mini near the courts and the nail studio) was not produced. It would have had to invent the venue's actual layout and the nail studio's frontage, which adds no information the two assets above do not already give. Flagged for the real shoot instead.
replaceWith: Real photographs of the kiosk, once a shoot happens. Delete this directory at that point.
realPhotographStaysPrimary: public/images/mini/mini-kiosk-sign.jpg — the genuine kiosk frontage remains the recognisable location image on cards and listings. The illustration never replaces it.
